name: ashpipe
description: Codex workflow support for ashpipe SSHFS workspaces.

interface.shortDescription: Mount ashpipe portals before native Codex file work.
interface.longDescription: Detect ashpipe workspaces, run ashpipe mount, and then use Codex native file tools against SSHFS-backed portal symlinks. The plugin keeps normal reads, edits, diffs, and searches native while warning against manual deletion of mounted portal paths.
defaultPrompt: Prepare this ashpipe workspace for Codex.
